hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: If a sequence has a positive bitwise and product, all elements in that sequence must share at least one common set bit position.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Iterate over each bit from 0 to 30. For a fixed bit, filter the array to only keep numbers with that bit set.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: For each filtered list, compute the longest strictly increasing sequence using patience sorting and binary search.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Iterates 31 bit positions, running patience sorting via binary search in O(n log n) time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: A brute force approach would exceed time limits by redundantly reprocessing states.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Balances linear traversal with auxiliary tracking structures.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects an optimal linear or logarithmic solution with edge-case handling.
